capabilities: browse frontmatter properties and distinct values with counts
filter property names and values from a search input
run Obsidian searches for a property or exact property/value pair
delete a property or value from matching notes via right-click menus
refresh the list manually from the metadata cache
extras: Manual install from release files only; delete actions have confirmation but no built-in undo; the README has a Limitations section.
intentEvidence: It is meant to feel like Obsidian's built-in All Properties panel, with one extra action
problem: Obsidian's All Properties panel lists property names but does not break properties down into their distinct values or let you act on those values.
summary: Sidebar view that browses frontmatter properties and their distinct values with counts, with search shortcuts and bulk delete actions.
